narration: Daylight makes it look like nothing. Just grass and wind and mud. I bagged a soil sample anyway — the lab says it hums. Not a sound you hear. A sound you feel in your teeth. At three a.m. they came again. They stood in rows, like pieces on a board, and did nothing at all. At exactly three thirty-three they turned and left — like a shift ending. I walked the rows after. Boot prints in the mud, dead center. Size eleven, worn on the left heel. I wear size eleven. I was awake all night. Wasn't I?

shots.prompt: Detective Aras Kaya (charcoal overcoat, collar up) walks alone through the vast grey daytime field under a flat overcast sky, grass whipping in the wind. He crouches and presses his bare palm flat against the soil, holding it there. Ends on: Aras looking up across the empty field.

Close on the precinct desk under the lamp at night: a soil sample in a sealed evidence bag, printed photos of the field, a map with red strings, and a whiteboard corner where '03:33' is circled twice in red marker. Slow drift across the desk. Ends on: the circled 03:33.

Night at the field: long lines of sleepwalkers in nightclothes file through the fence gap and wade into the moonlit grass and ground mist from several directions at once, silent and unhurried, breath fogging. Ends on: the crowd assembling in the mist.

Very wide elevated shot: dozens of sleepwalkers stand motionless in a perfect grid formation across the moonlit field, evenly spaced rows receding into mist, all facing the same way, breath fog rising in unison. Nothing else moves. Ends on: the immense silent grid under the moon.

In one synchronized motion every sleepwalker in the grid turns on the spot and begins walking calmly out of the field in different directions, dispersing through the mist like a crowd leaving work. Ends on: the emptying field, trampled grass where the grid stood.

Detective Aras Kaya (charcoal overcoat, flashlight in hand) walks the emptied grid alone, sweeping his beam over trampled grass and mud. The beam stops on a set of fresh boot prints pressed deep in the center. He slowly turns the light down onto his own boot beside them — the tread matches. Ends on: the flashlight beam trembling on his boot.
